headline: Mooring County Fighting Persists as Expanse Lines Shift
war_summary: Mooring County remains the war's heaviest affray: six ownership events in the past two hours and fifty-five in a day, 660 Colonial and 825 Warden casualties in the last two hours alone, and 7,017 against 7,308 across twenty-four. The fighting clusters at MacConmara Barrows, The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, leaving the region at seven Warden works, four Colonial and one unclaimed. The ledger now reads 307 Colonial works, 124 Warden and five neutral — the Wardens up three on the count filed three hours ago, with unclaimed ground narrowed by two. Weathered Expanse, scene of ninety-one events in a day and twenty-nine in six hours, has settled to four Warden works, three Colonial and two neutral. Pari Peak logged four events in two hours at Little Raakkua, Stlican Shelf one around Breaker Town and Briar, while Palantine Berm's seven events of the past six hours at The Pippeli Stones have since gone quiet. Callahan's Passage, ten Warden works strong, and Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua have recorded nothing in six hours. Thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
